opening.argument: The strongest reading of this presentation is an offer to pay for mining-pool participation in exchange for recurring Bitcoin earnings. The presenter states that, through the “mining pool, you're gonna get bitcoin bitcoin every single day, day in and day out,” while the displayed options require one-time purchases of $500, $1,000, or $2,000 for a share of mining profits over 1,000 days. The promotion also attaches additional financial benefit to referrals, saying “there's a lot of money going to go in your pocket if you refer people,” with sponsored purchases tied to team levels and bonuses. Although sponsoring is described as unnecessary for mining-pool profits and larger Bitcoin holdings are presented only as possible outcomes, the webinar still presents paid participation as an opportunity to join and earn.
